name: MonarchCallTile
title: CallTile
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box with overlays, androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility for reactions, androidx.compose.material3.IconButton or MonarchButton for actions, MonarchAvatar
summary: One participant in a call: their video or avatar, name, muted microphone, raised hand, status, connection quality and floating reactions, with Pin and full-screen buttons.
whenToUse: In the grid, the filmstrip or the main spot of a video call, one tile per participant, fed by the app's call SDK.
whenNotToUse: Not for a shared screen with zoom and pan; use MonarchScreenShareView. Not for the call's own controls; use buttons in the call screen's bar.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchCallTile(name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, statusTone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, size: MonarchCallTileSize = MonarchCallTileSize.Md, self: Boolean = false, micOff: Boolean = false, speaking: Boolean = false, handRaised: Boolean = false, screen: Boolean = false, pinned: Boolean = false, showVideo: Boolean = true, status: String? = null, quality: MonarchCallQuality? = null, reaction: MonarchCallReaction? = null, now: Long? = null, image: Painter? = null, onPinnedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onFullScreen: (() -> Unit)? = null, icons: MonarchCallTileIcons = MonarchCallTileIcons(), labels: MonarchCallTileLabels = MonarchCallTileLabels(), video: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
public enum class MonarchCallTileSize { Sm, Md, Lg }
public enum class MonarchCallQuality { Good, Fair, Poor }
public class MonarchCallReaction(emoji: String, sentAt: Long)

public class MonarchCallTileIcons(micOff: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, screen: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, handRaised: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, pin: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, unpin: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, fullScreen: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

public class MonarchCallTileLabels(you: ((String) -> String)? = null, muted: String? = null, sharingScreen: String? = null, handRaised: String? = null, speaking: String? = null, pin: ((String) -> String)? = null, unpin: ((String) -> String)? = null, fullScreen: ((String) -> String)? = null, pinButton: String? = null, unpinButton: String? = null, fullScreenButton: String? = null, reacted: ((name: String, emoji: String) -> String)? = null, quality: ((MonarchCallQuality) -> String)? = null)

options.name: name
options.description: The participant's display name. Names the tile and its buttons.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the tile. Give it a width; the height is at least 9/16 of it.

options.name: statusTone
options.description: The color of the status text.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm for the filmstrip (32dp avatar, no buttons), Md for the grid, Lg for the main spot.

options.name: self
options.description: This is the person using the app: "(you)" is added to the name.

options.name: micOff
options.description: The microphone is off: the muted mark in the name bar.

options.name: speaking
options.description: The participant is speaking: a 2dp accent border, and "Speaking" is read.

options.name: handRaised
options.description: A raised-hand badge at the top start corner.

options.name: screen
options.description: The video is a shared screen: the screen mark in the name bar.

options.name: pinned
options.description: Pinned to the main spot: the Pin button becomes Unpin and is marked selected.

options.name: showVideo
options.description: Shows the video slot. Pass false while connecting or when the camera is off.

options.name: status
options.description: A short status in the name bar, "Reconnecting…" or "Presenting".

options.name: quality
options.description: Three connection bars; null when unknown.

options.name: reaction
options.description: A reaction that rises over the tile for three seconds from sentAt.

options.name: now
options.description: The current time in epoch milliseconds, for tests. null reads the clock when a reaction arrives and when it ends.

options.name: image
options.description: The participant's picture for the avatar, loaded by the app. null shows initials.

options.name: onPinnedChange
options.description: Shows the Pin button, called with the next pinned state.

options.name: onFullScreen
options.description: Shows the full-screen button. The app presents the participant full screen.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icons for the muted, screen, hand, Pin and full-screen marks. Without an icon the word is written instead.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings.

options.name: video
options.description: The participant's video from the app's call SDK, filling the tile. Without it the avatar is shown.

states.name: avatar
states.description: Without video the avatar is centered on the emphasis background.

states.name: video
states.description: The slot fills the tile behind the overlays.

states.name: speaking
states.description: A 2dp border in the accent solid color.

states.name: muted
states.description: A crossed-out microphone icon or the word "Muted" in the name bar, in the danger color for the inverse surface.

states.name: hand raised
states.description: A solid warning badge with "Hand raised" (and the hand icon when given) at the top start corner.

states.name: pinned
states.description: The Pin button reads "Unpin Ana", shows the unpin icon or "Unpin", and is marked selected.

states.name: reaction
states.description: The emoji fades in and rises over the name bar, stays for three seconds from when it was sent, then fades. With animations removed it appears and disappears at once.

states.name: poor connection
states.description: One lit bar of three, in the danger solid color, and the spoken "Poor connection".

appearance: The tile on the emphasis background with 16dp corners; the name bar on the inverse surface with inverse text; status text in the tone's strong inverse color; icon buttons on the inverse surface, text buttons as small secondary MonarchButtons; the hand badge in the warning solid color; the speaking border in the accent solid color; lit connection bars in the success, warning or danger solid color. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web tile takes a MediaStream, mirrors your own camera and calls the Fullscreen API. On Android, as on iOS, the video is a slot for the call SDK's renderer (a SurfaceView or TextureView in an AndroidView, or the SDK's composable); mirroring is the renderer's job (for example setMirror on WebRTC's SurfaceViewRenderer) because a SurfaceView ignores Compose transforms, and full screen is the app's presentation through onFullScreen. Pinned is a value with onPinnedChange, as on the web. Reactions carry an epoch-millisecond sentAt; the tile reads the clock only when a reaction arrives and when it ends, and tests pass now. Monarch bundles no icons, so every mark has a written fallback and the icons are optional in MonarchCallTileIcons. The avatar is 40dp at most, the largest MonarchAvatar size, where the web uses its extra-large avatar. Hover-only buttons are always visible on touch screens. The web's "unknown" quality is null. The speaking border uses the accent color like iOS, where the web uses the success color.
accessibility: The tile is a traversal group; its name bar is one element read first, named "Ana (you)", with what is true now as its state: "Speaking, Muted, Hand raised, Sharing screen, Presenting, Poor connection".
Speaking is also a thicker border, muted and the hand are words or icons, and quality is the number of lit bars, so nothing depends on color alone.
Pin and full screen are buttons named "Pin Ana", "Unpin Ana" and "Show Ana full screen", with 48dp touch targets; Pin is marked selected while pinned.
A new reaction is announced through a polite live region as "Ana reacted 👏".
The video, the avatar and the hand badge are hidden from TalkBack; their meaning is in the name bar.
The tile grows taller at large font sizes so the name and status wrap instead of being cut.
edgeCases: A reaction with a sentAt in the future or three seconds or more ago is not shown.
Sending the same emoji again with a new sentAt plays it again.
A long name or status wraps in the name bar and makes the tile taller.
With showVideo false the slot is not composed, so a frozen frame never shows.
In a Row without a width the tile has no 16 by 9 minimum and is as tall as its content.

examples.title: States
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = {{tiles.0.name}},
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            self = {{tiles.0.self}},
            micOff = {{tiles.0.micOff}},
        )
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = {{tiles.1.name}},
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            speaking = {{tiles.1.speaking}},
            quality = MonarchCallQuality.{{tiles.1.quality|pascal}},
        )
    }
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = {{tiles.2.name}},
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            handRaised = {{tiles.2.handRaised}},
            quality = MonarchCallQuality.{{tiles.2.quality|pascal}},
        )
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = {{tiles.3.name}},
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            status = {{tiles.3.status}},
            statusTone = {{tiles.3.statusTone|tone}},
            quality = MonarchCallQuality.{{tiles.3.quality|pascal}},
        )
    }
}
examples.setupTemplate:
val icons = MonarchCallTileIcons(
    micOff = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.MicOff, contentDescription = null) },
    handRaised = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.RaiseHand, contentDescription = null) },
)
examples.setup:
val icons = MonarchCallTileIcons(

)
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = "Sam Lee",
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            self = true,
            micOff = true,
        )
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = "Robin Park",
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            speaking = true,
            quality = MonarchCallQuality.Good,
        )
    }
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = "Alex Chen",
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            handRaised = true,
            quality = MonarchCallQuality.Fair,
        )
        MonarchCallTile(
            name = "Jordan Diaz",
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            icons = icons,
            status = "Reconnecting…",
            statusTone = MonarchTone.Warning,
            quality = MonarchCallQuality.Poor,
        )
    }
}
